findings.title: Uncapped Delay Penalties
findings.deviation: Liquidated Damages. If Vendor fails to achieve any Delivery Date, Vendor shall pay AtliQ, as liquidated damages, an amount equal to two percent (2%) of the Total Fees for each calendar day from the Delivery Date until the date the applicable Deliverable is accepted.
findings.impact: Uncapped delay penalties are not acceptable. They can be excessive and may not be enforceable.
findings.quote: If Vendor fails to achieve any Delivery Date, Vendor shall pay AtliQ, as liquidated damages, an amount equal to two percent (2%) of the Total Fees for each calendar day from the Delivery Date until the date the applicable Deliverable is accepted.
findings.counterPosition: Liquidated damages should be capped at 0.5% of the affected milestone fee per week, with a maximum of 5% of that milestone fee, and no liquidated damages for client-caused delays. AtliQ's counter would be: 'If Vendor fails to achieve any Delivery Date, Vendor shall pay AtliQ, as liquidated damages, an amount equal to 0.5% of the affected milestone fee per week, with a maximum of 5% of that milestone fee, and no liquidated damages for client-caused delays.'
findings.linkedQuote: If Supplier is in default with a Milestone for reasons for which it is responsible, Client may claim a contractual penalty (Vertragsstrafe) of 0.5% of the Milestone Fee of the affected Milestone for each full week of delay, up to a maximum of 5% of that Milestone Fee.

findings.title: Uncapped Liability for Delay
findings.deviation: The Parties agree that AtliQ's aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the Fees actually paid by AtliQ to Vendor under this Agreement. Nothing in this Agreement shall limit or exclude Vendor's liability for any losses, whether direct or indirect, arising out of or relating to this Agreement, including Vendor's indemnification obligations.
findings.impact: AtliQ's liability is uncapped, which is not acceptable. Vendor's liability is also uncapped, which is not fair.
findings.quote: The Parties agree that AtliQ's aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the Fees actually paid by AtliQ to Vendor under this Agreement. Nothing in this Agreement shall limit or exclude Vendor's liability for any losses, whether direct or indirect, arising out of or relating to this Agreement, including Vendor's indemnification obligations.
findings.counterPosition: AtliQ's liability should be capped at 1× the fees paid in the 12 months prior to the claim. Vendor's liability should be capped at 1× the fees paid in the 12 months prior to the claim, with carve-outs limited to fraud, wilful misconduct, and breach of confidentiality. AtliQ's counter would be: 'AtliQ's aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed 1× the fees paid by AtliQ to Vendor in the 12 months prior to the claim. Vendor's liability for any losses, whether direct or indirect, arising out of or relating to this Agreement, including Vendor's indemnification obligations, shall be capped at 1× the fees paid by AtliQ to Vendor in the 12 months prior to the claim, with carve-outs limited to fraud, wilful misconduct, and breach of confidentiality.'
findings.linkedQuote: IN NO EVENT SHALL ATLIQ BE LIABLE TO VENDOR FOR ANY INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, CONSEQUENTIAL OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES, OR FOR LOST PROFITS, ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT.

findings.title: Vendor Indemnifies AtliQ for Its Own Negligence
findings.deviation: 9.1 **By Vendor.** Vendor shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless AtliQ, its Affiliates, and their respective directors, officers, employees, agents, successors and assigns (the 'AtliQ Indemnitees') from and against any and all Losses arising out of or relating to (a) the Services or Deliverables, (b) any breach of this Agreement by Vendor, (c) any claim by the End Client relating to the Services or Deliverables, or (d) any act or omission of Vendor Personnel, in each case regardless of whether such Losses are caused in whole or in part by the negligence of any AtliQ Indemnitee.
findings.impact: Vendor is required to indemnify AtliQ for its own negligence, which is not acceptable.
findings.quote: 9.1 **By Vendor.** Vendor shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless AtliQ, its Affiliates, and their respective directors, officers, employees, agents, successors and assigns (the 'AtliQ Indemnitees') from and against any and all Losses arising out of or relating to (a) the Services or Deliverables, (b) any breach of this Agreement by Vendor, (c) any claim by the End Client relating to the Services or Deliverables, or (d) any act or omission of Vendor Personnel, in each case regardless of whether such Losses are caused in whole or in part by the negligence of any AtliQ Indemnitee.
findings.counterPosition: Vendor shall indemnify AtliQ for third-party claims caused by its own breach or negligence, but not for its own negligence. AtliQ's counter would be: 'Vendor shall indemnify AtliQ for third-party claims caused by its own breach or negligence, but not for its own negligence.'
findings.linkedQuote: 9.1 **By Vendor.** Vendor shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless AtliQ, its Affiliates, and their respective directors, officers, employees, agents, successors and assigns (the 'AtliQ Indemnitees') from and against any and all Losses arising out of or relating to (a) the Services or Deliverables, (b) any breach of this Agreement by Vendor, (c) any claim by the End Client relating to the Services or Deliverables, or (d) any act or omission of Vendor Personnel, in each case regardless of whether such Losses are caused in whole or in part by the negligence of any AtliQ Indemnitee.

fine.note: The client's data protection obligations are not passed down to the vendor. This is a fair position for AtliQ.
The client's consent to subcontract is not passed down. This is a fair position for AtliQ.
The client's other obligations are not passed down. This is a fair position for AtliQ.
The client's intellectual property obligations are not passed down. This is a fair position for AtliQ.
The termination clause is fair for AtliQ, as it provides AtliQ with the right to terminate for convenience with payment for work done.
